cases.task: Choose the safe dashboard presentation rule for a long-lived SSE timeline that currently retains and rewrites every historical line on each event.

required_facts.text: Unbounded text retention consumes growing browser memory and repeated full-text concatenation becomes increasingly expensive during sustained traffic.
The newest operational evidence must remain visible while old presentation-only entries may be evicted without changing the durable SSE cursor.
Eviction must be explicit so the visible timeline is not mistaken for a complete audit log.
